# The Grad Scout

> AI-powered research, fit scoring, and application tracking for international students applying to master's programs abroad.

The Grad Scout researches master's programs against a student's profile (field, target country, tier, GPA, test scores), scores each program on fit, pulls live admissions, tuition, class-profile and career-outcome data, and tracks every application from shortlist to decision. It also includes alumni outreach, a resume builder, and an applicant community forum.
